mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 3% YoY, it signals a disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300,000 MoM does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or HOUST decline > 10% YoY does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 1% and INDPRO flat or declining
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of low GDPC1 growth and flat/declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
